# Ubuntu 24.04 packages for the test job container, installed by
# install_deps.sh (apt-get install --no-install-recommends). One package per
# line; '#' starts a comment.
#
# Python packages come from Ubuntu's apt archive (numpy 1.26, pytest, Pillow,
# pandas, matplotlib, OpenCV 4.6) so python3-opencv keeps its numpy ABI; only
# the CPU torch wheel comes from pip (requirements-test.txt, hash-pinned).

# Build tools for the shipped test trees and consumer projects.
build-essential
cmake
ninja-build
pkg-config
git
git-lfs
curl
ca-certificates
jq
file
binutils
patchelf
elfutils
time
procps
psmisc
util-linux
xz-utils
zstd
pigz

# python3-dev provides libpython, which the rocAL tests link (finding H1).
python3
python3-dev
python3-pip
python3-venv
python3-numpy
python3-pytest
python3-pil
python3-pandas
python3-matplotlib
python3-yaml
python3-opencv
libopencv-dev

# Host copies of the bundled libraries, loaded first by the loader-audit
# interposition checks (finding M1).
libjpeg-turbo8
libturbojpeg
liblmdb0
libprotobuf32t64
libsndfile1

# dpkg-dev and equivs build the local repository and stub packages for
# install-test; gh is the GitHub CLI.
dpkg-dev
equivs
gh
